correctness.rationale: Exact derivatives show saturated Jacobian ideal of two independent cubed linear forms, length 9 for any parameter; checked by symbolic modular polynomial arithmetic. On AB(A^2-B^2)!=0, the local translated equation has a single coprime (3,4) Newton edge with nonzero coefficients, so the germ is irreducible; no other singular point exists, ruling out reducible or repeated global components. Projection from the triple point birationally parametrizes the quartic, delta=3 by genus. Frobenius of that projection is the Gauss map, and projection from its smooth center S has inseparable degree 3, forcing the S+3T tangent intersection. Exact evaluation rank nine, jet determinant zero, and nonzero minor -ab prove unique interpolation. Explicit F27 point proves open nonempty. Source coefficients and witnesses replayed in actual verify_b3.py.
